name: GeoPilot Auto Play
description: Experimental obstacle-aware auto-play controller with in-game settings.

auto-play.description: Automatically react to recognized hazards during a level.

control-mode.description: Auto reads the player mode. Manual values override detection.

show-debug-log.description: Log controller decisions to the Geode log.
